instructions:
## Task objective

Curate a 1,000-row code instruction-tuning subset of OpenCodeInstruct (nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct, ~5M rows; mapped to {messages, id, domain, generation_algorithm, average_test_score}) so an SFT Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B- Instruct performs as well as possible on code benchmarks. Budget is 1K rows. Baseline: random. EVAL SCOPE: target_evals are functional-correctness pass@1 code benchmarks. Two tiers: - Tier A (offline, in-process code execution; run on the standard eval stage): HumanEval, MBPP. (HumanEval+ / MBPP+ EvalPlus tests are wired in the backend too.) - Tier B (own harness; execution validated on a code-exec-capable node): LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench. They are listed here as the full target suite; their run modules fail loudly if the official package/data is not provisioned on the eval node. Prompting uses the model's native ChatML chat template; metric is pass@1 (open-instruct n=1 @ temp 0.1 for HumanEval/MBPP). Absolute scores track the chosen harness implementations, not the paper's numbers exactly.

## Controlled curation loop

Inspect the supplied pool and implement a selection policy in the editable curation workspace. Produce the requested subset with the required schema, run the audit, and submit it through the benchmark CLI. The harness trains the fixed base model using the prescribed recipe and evaluates the checkpoint. Use the returned feedback to revise the selection policy. Do not alter the protected training or evaluation implementation.

## Exact published task configuration

```yaml
task:
  task_id: opencode_qwen1.5b_code4bench
  domain: code
  goal: >
    Curate a 1,000-row code instruction-tuning subset of OpenCodeInstruct
    (nvidia/OpenCodeInstruct, ~5M rows; mapped to {messages, id, domain,
    generation_algorithm, average_test_score}) so an SFT Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-
    Instruct performs as well as possible on code benchmarks. Budget is 1K rows.
    Baseline: `random`.

    EVAL SCOPE: target_evals are functional-correctness pass@1 code benchmarks.
    Two tiers:
      - Tier A (offline, in-process code execution; run on the standard eval
        stage): HumanEval, MBPP. (HumanEval+ / MBPP+ EvalPlus tests are wired in
        the backend too.)
      - Tier B (own harness; execution validated on a code-exec-capable node):
        LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench. They are listed here as the full target
        suite; their run modules fail loudly if the official package/data is not
        provisioned on the eval node.
    Prompting uses the model's native ChatML chat template; metric is pass@1
    (open-instruct n=1 @ temp 0.1 for HumanEval/MBPP). Absolute scores track the
    chosen harness implementations, not the paper's numbers exactly.
  target_rows: 1000
  training_stage: finetuning
  model_key: qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-instruct
  model_name_or_path: __MODEL_PATH__
  target_evals:
    - HumanEval
    - MBPP
    - LiveCodeBench
    - BigCodeBench
  strategy_timeout_seconds: null
  default_submission_dir: curated/final_submission
  training_config:
    # OpenCodeInstruct-adapted recipe (train_opencode_sft.py owns it): lr 5e-6,
    # cosine, max_seq_len 2048, bf16, 3 epochs, full FT. num_processes drives a
    # single-GPU run.
    num_processes: 1
    timeout_seconds: 14400
  eval_config:
    benchmarks:
      - HumanEval
      - MBPP
      - LiveCodeBench
      - BigCodeBench
    offline: true
    mode: all
    timeout_seconds: 36000
    gpu_id: 0
  dataset:
    dataset_id: opencodeinstruct
    local_path: __DATASET_PATH__
    split: null
```

Configuration source: [curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/opencode_qwen1.5b_code4bench.yaml](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/curation-bench/src/benchmark/tasks/opencode_qwen1.5b_code4bench.yaml), [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/Jiachen-T-Wang/curation-bench-pro/blob/fb418bc9ce1c52416550ba6abf5968d8d594c760/LICENSE).
